decision.explanation: Both awards are directly supported by the original sources. Document d1 explicitly states that William Rooke Creswell was presented with the Robert Falla Memorial Award at the Australian Museum. Document d2 confirms that he was appointed a Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire in 1911. These are two distinct awards from separate contexts—ornithology and military service—and both are clearly attributed to Creswell in the provided sources.
